reply: Done: a catalogue of ~150 datasets in 16 themes, with a download plan (tier 1 ~9 GB, tier 2 ~45 GB, all without accounts). Best ideas: a climate month slider (800 m normals), a fall-foliage engine (peak-colour date and palette per road), a storm time machine (radar since 1995, tornado and hurricane tracks, snowstorm footprints), a history time machine (an 1830 map of the state!), an "old New England" road score (every building's year built), quiet and safe roads (traffic, deer-crash corridors), live tides, dark skies, valley fog. Saved in the lab folder on the NAS (scenic-lab/massachusetts/research)
text: Brainstorm and research every kind of data the map could show for Massachusetts (weather in depth)
